raw_nwp_rainfall.name: raw_nwp_rainfall
raw_nwp_rainfall.derivation: Accumulated surface precipitation over forecast window

u850.name: u850
u850.description: Zonal wind velocity at 850 hPa isobaric level (positive eastward)

v850.name: v850
v850.description: Meridional wind velocity at 850 hPa isobaric level (positive northward)

mslp.name: mslp
mslp.derivation: Reduced surface pressure to sea level

relative_humidity.name: relative_humidity
relative_humidity.derivation: Vapour pressure relative to saturation vapour pressure

cape.name: cape
cape.derivation: Vertical integral of parcel buoyant energy

geopotential_height.name: geopotential_height
geopotential_height.description: Geopotential height at 500 hPa isobaric surface
geopotential_height.derivation: Geopotential divided by standard gravity g0 (9.80665 m/s^2)

wind_speed_850.name: wind_speed_850
wind_speed_850.description: Horizontal wind speed magnitude at 850 hPa

wind_direction_850.name: wind_direction_850
wind_direction_850.description: Meteorological wind direction at 850 hPa (degrees clockwise from North, indicating direction from which wind blows)

rainfall_mean_3x3.name: rainfall_mean_3x3
rainfall_mean_3x3.description: 3x3 grid neighborhood mean of NWP raw rainfall forecast
rainfall_mean_3x3.derivation: Spatial 3x3 uniform convolution on NWP rainfall grid at valid time

rainfall_max_3x3.name: rainfall_max_3x3
rainfall_max_3x3.description: 3x3 grid neighborhood maximum of NWP raw rainfall forecast
rainfall_max_3x3.derivation: Spatial 3x3 max pooling on NWP rainfall grid at valid time

rainfall_std_3x3.name: rainfall_std_3x3
rainfall_std_3x3.description: 3x3 grid neighborhood standard deviation of NWP raw rainfall
rainfall_std_3x3.derivation: Spatial 3x3 local standard deviation on NWP rainfall grid

elevation.name: elevation
elevation.description: Terrain surface elevation above mean sea level from DEM
elevation.derivation: Bilinear interpolation from Digital Elevation Model (SRTM/CartoDEM)

distance_to_coast.name: distance_to_coast
distance_to_coast.description: Shortest geodesic distance to Indian coastline
distance_to_coast.derivation: Minimum Haversine distance to digitized coastline geometry

day_of_year_sin.name: day_of_year_sin
day_of_year_sin.description: Sine component of annual seasonal cycle

day_of_year_cos.name: day_of_year_cos
day_of_year_cos.description: Cosine component of annual seasonal cycle

valid_hour_sin.name: valid_hour_sin
valid_hour_sin.description: Sine component of diurnal diurnal cycle

valid_hour_cos.name: valid_hour_cos
valid_hour_cos.description: Cosine component of diurnal diurnal cycle

pre_monsoon.name: pre_monsoon
pre_monsoon.description: IMD Pre-monsoon season indicator (March to May)

monsoon.name: monsoon
monsoon.description: IMD Southwest Monsoon season indicator (June to September)

post_monsoon.name: post_monsoon
post_monsoon.description: IMD Post-monsoon season indicator (October to December)

winter.name: winter
winter.description: IMD Winter season indicator (January to February)

ensemble_mean_rainfall.name: ensemble_mean_rainfall
ensemble_mean_rainfall.description: Ensemble mean precipitation forecast across all available members

ensemble_std_rainfall.name: ensemble_std_rainfall
ensemble_std_rainfall.description: Ensemble spread (standard deviation) across forecast members

ensemble_min_rainfall.name: ensemble_min_rainfall
ensemble_min_rainfall.description: Ensemble minimum precipitation forecast across members

ensemble_max_rainfall.name: ensemble_max_rainfall
ensemble_max_rainfall.description: Ensemble maximum precipitation forecast across members
